svg.text: STAGE 1 — RAW TELEMETRY INPUT (from Edge Sensor + Historical Memory Module)
STAGE 2 — FEATURE TRANSFORMATIONS (5 Parallel Transformation Streams)
Purpose: Allows MLP to treat each
No geo-location data in these flags.
STAGE 3 — FINAL 10-DIMENSIONAL FEATURE TENSOR x ∈ ℝ¹⁰
x = [v_ratio, d_ratio, road_dry, road_wet, road_snow, up_vel, dn_den, weather, acc_flag, roadwork] ∈ ℝ¹⁰
x ∈ ℝ¹⁰ → OOD Threshold Guard → EventClassifierMLP(10→64→8) → Softmax → 8-Class Prediction
Check: x[0] > 3.0 OR x[1] > 7.0 → ood_warning flag
* x[5] and x[6] are imputed to 0.0 when upstream/downstream neighbor segment data is unavailable (sensor unreachable or feed offline)
This is a deterministic structural decision, not a dynamic runtime check — the imputation happens unconditionally when those fields are absent from the telemetry record
